verdict.rationale: Docs confirm companies can have multiple work locations and can choose different pay schedules per location/team, plus multi-location management and processing-speed options (next-day/2-day/4-day), which supports the general capability of varying payroll cadence across teams. However, there is no explicit documentation naming the specific weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly schedule types or showing how an ops user configures them, and no independent corroboration of this multi-schedule setup in practice. missing for 10: explicit list of supported pay-schedule frequencies, UI/API walkthrough for configuring per-team schedules, independent/hands-on confirmation.
